organization: State Register of Legal Entities, Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Armenia
notes: Authoritative Armenian company/legal-entities register (Ministry of Justice). The site offers a free public company search, but it is protected by RADWARE BOT MANAGER: e-register.am/en and /companies redirect to validate.perfdrive.com (bot validation), and e-register.moj.am redirects to /hy/. No open bulk or free API. Not bypassed. Key = state registration number + TIN (ՀՎՀՀ / HVHH, 8-digit). Director/founders are personal data. Field model from public knowledge; nothing captured.

organization: State Revenue Committee of the Republic of Armenia (SRC)
notes: The SRC website hosts a public taxpayer search (the /en/search page is a large search interface; internal endpoints include /searchTaxpayerData, /singleSearchResult). Browser-public lookup by TIN (ՀՎՀՀ) / name returning taxpayer name and status (and VAT status); per-TIN AJAX, not a bulk download or documented open API. Identifier = TIN (HVHH, 8-digit). Confirm whether an open VAT-payers list is published.

Armenia Securities Exchange. The site is a JavaScript SPA — static fetches return an empty shell (~3 KB); listed-instrument data is loaded client-side and no clean public JSON API was found (guessed api.amx.am / amx.am/api endpoints 404 or returned the shell). Browser-public but not cleanly automatable from here. Listed securities only; small market (AMX lists equities and bonds; ISIN AMxxxxxxxxxx).

CKAN portal (package_search works). A q=company search returns 10 datasets, all research/survey/sectoral (IFC projects, enterprise survey, drug-expertise centre, MIX Market) — NOT a company register. 'legal entities' / 'juridical' / 'petakan' searches return 0. No authoritative company-register dataset. Listed for completeness; not used as a company source. (data.gov.am and petakamutner.am do not resolve.)
